key_insight: FlashRT introduces an agent harness that helps automatically guide the deployment of real-time multimodal AI applications, reducing the need for hand-crafted system implementations. It focuses on making application-specific choices such as model placement, streaming, and parallelism to improve performance.
problem_solved: Real-time multimodal apps like voice agents and interactive video generation are hard to deploy efficiently because they combine multiple heterogeneous models with different runtime needs. Existing serving systems and auto-parallelism tools are too rigid, forcing developers to manually engineer high-performance deployments.
method: Uses an agent-based harness to explore deployment decisions for multimodal pipelines.
Supports optimization across placement, streaming, and intra-model parallelism.
Adapts to application-specific workload characteristics instead of relying on fixed assumptions.
impact: This matters because it can make it much easier to deploy high-performance real-time AI applications without extensive systems expertise. Practitioners may get better latency and efficiency while spending less time hand-tuning infrastructure.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing multiple models connected in a real-time multimodal app
Decision flowchart for placement, streaming, and parallelism choices
Before-and-after comparison chart of manual tuning vs. FlashRT-guided deployment
Icons representing voice, video, agents, and compute infrastructure
paper_title: FlashRT: Agent Harness for Guiding Agents to Deploy Real-Time Multimodal Applications
paper_authors: Krish Agarwal, Zhuoming Chen, Yanyuan Qin, Zhenyu Gu, Atri Rudra
